articles.title: Married Woman and Teen Lover Kill 6-Year-Old to Hide Their Affair After She Catches Them
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Hathras a 33-year-old married woman Pinky Sharma and her 17 year old lover have been arrested for the murder of a 6 year old girl. The incident, which occurred on September 3rd, was a cold-blooded act committed to silence the child who had witnessed their illicit affair.

body.html:
In Hathras a 33-year-old married woman Pinky Sharma and her 17 year old lover have been arrested for the murder of a 6 year old girl. The incident, which occurred on September 3rd, was a cold-blooded act committed to silence the child who had witnessed their illicit affair.

The victim, identified as Urvi, was playing near her home when she accidentally entered her neighbour Pinky's house. It was there that she allegedly saw Pinky and the teenage boy "objectionable position." Fearful that the young girl would expose their secret, the duo allegedly strangled her to death.

In a desperate attempt to conceal the crime, the accused wrapped the child's body in a white towel, stuffed it into an empty paddy sack, and threw it into a dry well located just 25 meters from the victim's home.

The girl's disappearance earlier that morning Led to massive search by her family and police, who later discovered the grim contents of the sack.

During interrogation, Pinky reportedly confessed to the crime. A key piece of evidence was a bite mark on her hand, sustained when the little girl fought for her life in self-defense. The minor male accomplice has also been taken into custody.

The girl's father had initially filed a missing complaint, which was later converted to a murder case. While initial family suspicions had fallen on another relative, a rigorous police investigation led them to the neighbour. Both accused have now been sent to judicial custody, with the minor being sent to a juvenile home.

articles.title: Moradabad Woman Dies After Alleged Acid Forcing by In-Laws Over Dowry
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moradabad – A 22-year-old woman, Gulfiza, has died after a harrowing 17-day struggle in hospital, with her parents alleging she was forced by her in-laws to drink acid over dowry demands. The case has sparked anger in Nagla Banveer village, where Gulfiza was the eldest of five daughters.

body.html:
Moradabad – A 22-year-old woman, Gulfiza, has died after a harrowing 17-day struggle in hospital, with her parents alleging she was forced by her in-laws to drink acid over dowry demands. The case has sparked anger in Nagla Banveer village, where Gulfiza was the eldest of five daughters.

Gulfiza had married Parvez of Amroha just six months earlier. According to her parents, happiness turned to horror when the in-laws allegedly began demanding ₹10 lakh and repeatedly assaulting her. On 11 August, they claim, she was beaten and forced to swallow acid.

Her father, Mohammad Furqan, said, “She kept vomiting blood, telling her mother, ‘Don’t cry, I’ll be fine. Allah will punish Parvez and his family.’” Gulfiza remained in ICU for 13 days before being discharged. When her condition worsened, the family says crucial treatment papers had been taken away by her father-in-law, forcing hospitals to refuse readmission. She died on 27 August en route back to Moradabad after multiple hospitals, including AIIMS and Safdarjung, allegedly declined admission.

Furqan has filed an FIR naming husband Parvez, parents-in-law Aseem and Gulista, brothers-in-law Monis and Saif, and uncles Bhura and Babbo for dowry harassment and murder. Only Parvez has been arrested so far. Police have sealed the house in Kalakheda, where the other accused remain absconding.

Gulfiza’s uncle Rehan Ali alleges the in-laws “removed treatment records to hide the acid attack.” The grieving family seeks strict action against all accused, an inquiry into hospital negligence, and government compensation for mounting medical debts.

Neighbours offered conflicting statements, with one claiming Gulfiza ingested the acid herself during an argument. Investigating officer CO City Shakti Singh said, “We have Parvez in custody. Raids are underway to arrest the remaining accused. Murder sections have been added after the post-mortem.”

articles.title: Sialkot Harasser's Gun 'Accidentally' Misfires, Inflicts Permanent Injury During Raid
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: SIALKOT: A man, wanted for allegedly harassing a woman, sustained a severe and permanently damaging injury after his pistol accidentally discharged and struck him in his private parts during a police raid on Thursday.

body.html:
SIALKOT: A man, wanted for allegedly harassing a woman, sustained a severe and permanently damaging injury after his pistol accidentally discharged and struck him in his private parts during a police raid on Thursday.

The accused, identified as Muhammad Irfan, was wanted by the Counter Crime Department (CCD) after a video of him engaging in inappropriate conduct towards a woman went viral on social media. The incident occurred as the woman was entering her residence.

According to an official statement from the CCD, a police team conducted a raid to arrest the suspect. Upon their arrival, Irfan allegedly pulled out a pistol intending to fire at the officers. However, in a panicked state, the weapon accidentally discharged, and the bullet hit the suspect himself, causing critical injuries to his private parts.

Officials confirmed that the self-inflicted wound has resulted in permanent damage. The injured suspect was immediately shifted to a hospital for treatment. Legal proceedings in the case are currently underway.

articles.title: Stray Bull Terror in Lucknow: Vijay Rastogi & Grandson Injured in Khajuha Attack
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow – Panic gripped the Khajuha locality under Municipal Corporation Zone-2 when a herd of stray bulls attacked a local resident, Vijay Rastogi, and his young grandson. The incident left both injured and raised fresh concerns about unchecked stray cattle on city roads.

body.html:
Lucknow – Panic gripped the Khajuha locality under Municipal Corporation Zone-2 when a herd of stray bulls attacked a local resident, Vijay Rastogi, and his young grandson. The incident left both injured and raised fresh concerns about unchecked stray cattle on city roads.

Eyewitnesses said the bulls, roaming freely in the area, suddenly charged at Rastogi and the child, causing chaos among bystanders. Locals rushed to rescue the duo and shifted them for medical attention. Residents allege repeated complaints about stray cattle menace have gone unanswered.

Authorities are yet to confirm action, but locals demand immediate steps to curb the growing threat of stray animals in residential zones.

articles.title: Gold Stolen at Red Fort Jain Event: Fake Priest Vanishes with ₹1.5 Crore Ritual Treasures
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – In a serious security lapse, two golden ‘kalash’ and other valuables worth about ₹1.5 crore were stolen from a Jain religious gathering held at the 15 August Park inside Delhi’s Red Fort.

body.html:
New Delhi – In a serious security lapse, two golden ‘kalash’ and other valuables worth about ₹1.5 crore were stolen from a Jain religious gathering held at the 15 August Park inside Delhi’s Red Fort. The theft occurred on Wednesday during the ongoing Daslakshan Mahaparv, a 10-day festival.

According to the FIR, the missing items include a golden ‘jhari’ (urn), a 760-gram gold coconut, and a 115-gram smaller ‘jhari’ embedded with diamonds, emeralds, and rubies. The artefacts, used in Jain rituals, belong to businessman Sudhir Jain, who regularly brought them for ceremonial use.

CCTV footage shows the thief dressed as a Jain priest walking away with a bag suspected to contain the valuables. Police confirmed the suspect has been identified and assured an arrest soon.

Organisers say the items disappeared while preparations were underway to receive guests. “The thief took advantage of the rush. These objects are tied to our faith beyond their monetary worth,” Sudhir Jain told reporters. Puneet Jain, a relative, claimed the same individual had earlier targeted three other temples.

Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla attended the event a day before the incident. The religious programme will continue until 9 September.

articles.title: Meerut Violence: Youth Stabbed to Death During Ganesh Visarjan Procession, Two Accused Named
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut (U.P.): Tragedy struck during Ganesh idol immersion in Sardhana when Bobby Gautam was fatally stabbed amid loud DJ music, his cries for help drowned out by the sound system. Police say the assault followed an old dispute at a local gym between Bobby and the accused.

body.html:
Meerut (U.P.): Tragedy struck during Ganesh idol immersion in Sardhana when Bobby Gautam was fatally stabbed amid loud DJ music, his cries for help drowned out by the sound system.

Police say the assault followed an old dispute at a local gym between Bobby and the accused. The incident occurred late at night as two groups clashed during the procession. Bobby, stabbed in the chest, was rushed to hospital but died during treatment.

An FIR has been registered at Sardhana Police Station against Shekhar, Abhishek and others. Police have already arrested two suspects and detained two more for questioning.

Superintendent of Police said both parties were acquainted and belong to the same community. Video evidence from the scene is being examined, and further legal action is underway.

articles.title: Youth Beaten With Slippers in Public for ‘Roaming’ With Girlfriend, Video Sparks Anger
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hamirpur (U.P.): A shocking case of street assault has surfaced from Jalalpur Road, Rath Kotwali area, where a young man was thrashed with slippers by his girlfriend’s family members in full public view.

body.html:
Hamirpur (U.P.): A shocking case of street assault has surfaced from Jalalpur Road, Rath Kotwali area, where a young man was thrashed with slippers by his girlfriend’s family members in full public view.

Eyewitnesses said the youth was walking hand-in-hand with the girl when her relatives caught him, dragged him aside and repeatedly struck him with slippers, even as he fell to the ground. Bystanders reportedly watched silently, filming the incident instead of intervening.

A video clip of the assault has gone viral on social media, drawing condemnation over public apathy and mob justice.

Hamirpur police confirmed the episode and said an inquiry is underway. “Appropriate legal action will follow based on the investigation,” officials stated.
